item.title: H&M and Stella McCartney launch sustainability 'insights board'
item.description: H&M and Stella McCartney have unveiled the members of a new "insights board", aimed at driving industry dialogue around sustainability, as part of their ongoing collaboration announced in December.

item.title: Walpole: Why UK-India trade deal is 'one of the most significant growth opportunities' for British luxury
item.description: As fashion retailers and suppliers urge the government to take action and outline a timeline for the UK-India free trade deal (FTA), Helen Brocklebank, chief executive officer at Walpole, shares her thoughts on the opportunity for British luxury.

item.title: Sustainability and the Consumer 2026
item.description: Sustainability is now a decisive force in consumer’s shopping behaviours – but a gap remains between what consumers say and what they shop. Drapers’ latest research, based on an exclusive survey of 2,000 UK shoppers and insights from 20 leading brands and retailers, reveals how the conscious consumer is evolving – and what this means for your business strategy.

item.title: Drapers' shopper survey: the evolution of the conscious consumer
item.description: Our latest consumer research reveals strong demand for sustainable fashion, with 83% of UK shoppers factoring it into purchase decisions. However, an enduring gap between intent and action – driven by affordability, uncertainty and scepticism – means brands and retailers must deliver credible, accessible solutions to turn growing awareness into real opportunity.

item.title: Hackett owner names new CEO
item.description: AWWG, which owns fashion brands including Pepe Jeans London, Hackett London and Façonnable, has promoted CFO Laura Fernandez Plaza to the role of CEO, succeeding Marcella Wartenbergh after seven years in the role.

item.title: Retail staff pay tracker: What are the latest hourly rates?
item.description: Drapers rounds up the latest investments in hourly pay across fashion retail in 2026.

item.title: Asda ups staff pay by 4%
item.description: Supermarket chain Asda has announced an above-inflation pay rise of 4% for retail staff, reflecting an £80m investment in pay this year.

item.title: Asos profits up as it reaffirms full-year guidance
item.description: Asos has reported a surge in profits and maintained its full-year guidance in a pre-close trading update for the first half of the financial year published today (25 March).

item.title: Inflation holds firm at 3% in February
item.description: Inflation remained unchanged at 3% in February, according to the latest Office for National Statistics (ONS) Consumer Prices Index (CPI).

item.title: Vivobarefoot on B Corp’s overhaul: ‘Continuous improvement rather than a static badge’
item.description: In February, B Corp overhauled its certification framework with stricter minimum requirements. This B Corp Month, head of sustainability at Vivobarefoot, Charlotte Pumford, explains why the footwear brand welcomes these changes.
